title: FACE: Flow-Guided Angular Channel Estimation Framework for mmWave MIMO Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.21698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Acquiring accurate channel state information (CSI) is essential for millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. However, it remains challenging due to high-dimensional channels, limited pilot observations, and measurement noise. To address these challenges, we propose flow-guided angular channel estimation (FACE), a novel channel estimation framework based on flow matching, an emerging generative modeling paradigm that learns continuous transport dynamics between probability distributions. FACE exploits the inherent angular-domain sparsity of mmWave channels and incorporates the learned flow matching model as a generative channel prior. Numerical results show that FACE consistently achieves higher channel estimation accuracy than both conventional estimators and diffusion-based generative estimator across diverse channel and system configurations. translated_title: FACE：面向毫米波MIMO系统的流引导角度信道估计框架
translated_abstract: 获取精确的信道状态信息（CSI）对于毫米波（mmWave）多输入多输出（MIMO）系统至关重要。然而，由于高维信道、有限的导频观测以及测量噪声，这仍然充满挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了流引导角度信道估计（FACE），这是一种基于流匹配的新型信道估计框架。流匹配是一种新兴的生成式建模范式，能够学习概率分布之间的连续传输动力学。FACE利用毫米波信道固有的角度域稀疏性，并将学习到的流匹配模型作为生成式信道先验。数值结果表明，在多种信道和系统配置下，FACE的信道估计精度始终高于传统估计器以及基于扩散模型的生成式估计器。此外，FACE在导频观测较少的情况下仍能保持较高的估计精度。
tldr: 提出了基于流匹配的流引导角度信道估计框架FACE，利用毫米波信道的角度域稀疏性作为生成式信道先验，其估计精度在不同配置下均优于传统估计器和基于扩散的生成式估计器，且在导频较少时仍保持高精度。
en_tdlr: FACE, a flow matching-based angular channel estimation framework that leverages the angular-domain sparsity of mmWave channels as a generative prior, consistently achieves higher estimation accuracy than conventional and diffusion-based estimators while maintaining robust performance with fewer pilot observations.
